name: PUT mapping with duplicate dynamic template names emits a warning

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.6.0-4ee29c5118ca24a69979fd0b073042a25ea8b591 "Dynamic template [my_template] in index [test_dup_templates] is defined more than once. It is not defined which of the duplicate definitions takes effect. Defining multiple dynamic templates with the same name will be rejected in a future version."
